delivery_contract_proposal.limitations_text: Forecast, not observed weather or a guarantee. Temperature is at each interval start; probability concerns more than 0.1 mm in the preceding hour ending at each interval end. The lowest-probability interval is not a promise of dry or safe conditions. Data capture time is known; forecast model issuance time is not established. Grid-cell coordinates may differ from the requested point. Source data and access rights are not certified by FAHCE.

scope: PUBLIC FIXTURE ONLY; no customer, consent, or wallet
